notes: duelist: AI_DUELIST_* (include/ai.h) or DUELIST_* (include/overworld.h); use a JSON array for multiple story duelist IDs that share one clip.
card_id uses CARD_* defines from include/constants/card_ids.h.
replace_vanilla: when true, skip the vanilla clip for the same trigger type.
WAV files live under src_custom/assets/voices/ (mono or stereo; resampled at build).
